https://armenopole.com/young-prodigies-o: The Young Prodigies of Armenia, a new generation of talented musicians, embark on a Swiss tour from October 24 to 31, 2026. https://armenopole.com/ara-malikian-pres: Violinist Ara Malikian and his band blend classical, jazz, Romani music and flamenco in “Intruso”, a virtuosic, genre-crossing performance.

https://armenopole.com/ateliers-mantis.h: The Armenian Women's Union hosts friendly workshops to prepare mantis for the annual church fair. Maral Torossian, Lilia and Vatché Markoussian lead these sessions open to everyone, including beginners.
https://armenopole.com/prima-del-mito-se: Violinist Sergei Mkrtichian performs "Prima del mito", a solo recital spanning 1720 (Bach, Telemann, Locatelli) and 1820 (Paganini Caprices). Free admission.
https://armenopole.com/benefizkonzert-fu: Anniversary evening marking 25 years of partnership between YMCA Spitak and Cevi Zürich, featuring a live link to Spitak. The collection exclusively supports Cevi Zürich's work in Armenia.
https://armenopole.com/parce-qu-ils-sont: Musical theatre by Pinar Selek, performed by Lorianne Cherpillod and Mathilde Soutter, a committed work resonating as both tribute and reflection on Armenian identity.
https://armenopole.com/55e-grande-fete-a: The 55th Grande Fête Arménienne in Geneva features an oriental buffet, Armenian specialties, traditional dances, and tavli and chess tournaments. Organized by the Union of Ladies of the Armenian Apostolic Church, the event has a warm, festive community atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/ballet-sheherezad: Italy's national company Balletto di Milano makes its Swiss debut with « Shéhérazade. https://armenopole.com/artzakank-echo-fe: Artzakank marks its 40th anniversary in Geneva with a round table on transmission, volunteer associations and the diaspora featuring Hilda Tchoboian, Valentina Calzolari and Vicken Cheterian, followed by a reception.
https://armenopole.com/salon-gout-et-ter: The Salon Goût et Terroir in Fribourg honors Armenia as the 2026 guest country alongside Swissmilk. The event celebrates a cuisine of sharing and local terroir products.
https://armenopole.com/gor-sujyan-one-ma: Gor Sujyan performs solo as One Man Band, delivering a pop-rock concert where he sings and plays multiple instruments alone on stage.
https://armenopole.com/daughters-of-vart: The Daughters of Vartan's Tzouig Otyag #33 marks its 5th anniversary with a gala on October 23, 2027. The Armenian community organization is hosting the celebratory event. More details will be announced soon.
https://armenopole.com/ceremonie-de-la-s: The memorial ceremony at the stele of remembrance in Margny-lès-Compiègne, originally scheduled for October 24, has been cancelled and postponed to a later date.
https://armenopole.com/323ydsgn.html: Gayané - Danzas Armenias performs traditional Armenian dance as part of CulturaFest 2026 in Uruguay.
https://armenopole.com/montebello-holy-c: The Holy Cross Armenian Food Fair & Fest in Montebello features specialties like kebabs, Hye Nachos, and pastries. Live entertainment includes Suro, Hosharian Band, and DJ Shaunt, plus a backgammon tournament, beer garden, and Kidz Zone for family fun.
https://armenopole.com/fall-fest.html: The Fall Fest features an Armenian dinner (beef, chicken, lamb, losh) with pilaf, salad, pita, pastries, choreg, and kebab dessert, accompanied by fellowship music. The event is organized by the FAC (First Armenian Church) in Belmont, Massachusetts.
https://armenopole.com/calendar-lebbeus-: Asia Society and the Armenian General Benevolent Union present the "Our Century: Spiraling Paths Through Armenian Cinema" series, screening Atom Egoyan's "Calendar" preceded by Arby Ovanessian's "Lebbeus/Thaddeus".
https://armenopole.com/armenian-wine-har: The Armenian Wine & Harvest Festival 2026, organised by Chronos Social Production, celebrates Armenian culture in London through wine, food, music and traditions. The event features tastings, an interactive VINESINE LAB experience, cultural performances and fundraising to support Armenian wineries.
https://armenopole.com/sip-paint-with-va: Local Armenian artist Vahe Ashodian leads a fun-filled Sip & Paint afternoon. The event is organized by the Artemis Chapter of Philadelphia of the Armenian Relief Society – USA. Step-by-step painting with all supplies, drinks and appetizers provided.
https://armenopole.com/von-der-elegie-zu: As part of the Armenian Cultural Days in Stuttgart, Anush Nikoghosyan (violin), Diana Sahakyan (piano) and Vache Bagratuni (cello) perform a chamber concert of Rachmaninoff and Arno Babadjanian, bridging melancholy and renewal.
https://armenopole.com/bcybjeoi.html: The Prof Art Dance Studio and the Héginé Tsaroukian Dance Studio jointly present the treasures of Armenian folk dance on one stage, accompanied by the sounds of traditional instruments such as the dhol, zurna, kamancha, and qanun. The event highlights the vital mission of preserving and passing down Armenian cultural heritage—folk songs and dances—to future generations.
https://armenopole.com/balade-contee.htm: The Cpa offers a poetic storytelling walk through its spaces with tales from here and abroad, followed by a tasting of Armenian specialties.
https://armenopole.com/last-station.html: Asia Society presents Our Century: Spiraling Paths Through Armenian Cinema, five films by Armenian filmmakers from around the world and across different periods. Last Station follows Egyptian-Armenian actors Nora Armani and Gérald Papasian as they travel to Los Angeles in search of the American dream. They stage a theatrical performance based on Armenian poetry and begin touring the world. Enriched with poetry, music, and poetic urban landscapes, the film becomes a meditation on shattered dreams, longing, belonging, and the possibility of continuing the journey.
https://armenopole.com/last-station-film: Asia Society and the Armenian General Benevolent Union present "Last Station", a film following Egyptian-Armenian actors Nora Armani and Gérald Papasian in Los Angeles. This screening is part of the "Our Century: Spiraling Paths Through Armenian Cinema" series exploring identity and belonging.
https://armenopole.com/concerto-di-piano: The piano concert of the 2026 Alatone International Competition finalists features young pianists performing Khachaturian, Chopin, Rachmaninoff, and Armenian composers. Organised by Alatone International under President Saule Tanekeyeva.
https://armenopole.com/agbu-alumni-schol: The AGBU London Chapter hosts the Scholars & Alumni Connect at the Armenian House (Hye Doon) in London. The gathering brings together past and current AGBU scholarship recipients and alumni from across AGBU programmes. An evening of networking, community building, and updates on upcoming AGBU initiatives.
https://armenopole.com/armenian-film-fes: The Armenian Film Festival Australia takes place in Perth for the first time, organised by Armenian Film Festival Australia.
https://armenopole.com/gottesdienst-germ: An Armenian divine service will take place at St. Pius Church in Bremen. The liturgy is organised by the local Armenian community in a traditional worship setting.
St. Nshan Cathedral in Beirut kicks off its 175th anniversary with an opening kermesse. The Revival Band performs live alongside the AGBU-AYA "Arine" Dance Group, the Hamazkayin Art Schools "Damidom" Dhol Ensemble, and the Cathedral Youth Community's Music Club. The celebration is organized by the Youth Community under the blessing of Archbishop Shahe Panossian.
https://armenopole.com/willing-the-good-: An evening to encourage and strengthen marriages with speaker Der Nareg Terterian, an Armenian priest and licensed mental health counselor. The event includes dinner, music, teaching, and fellowship, sponsored by the Clergy of New England.
https://armenopole.com/october-kef-autum: A fundraiser for the Armenian Cultural Conservancy's tenth anniversary, featuring a full Armenian mezze buffet and dancing to the Andrew Hagopian Ensemble.

https://armenopole.com/roots-to-rhythm.h: Adana Dance Studio presents "Roots to Rhythm," a dance performance celebrating Armenian heritage through traditional dances and timeless hits, taking audiences on a journey from roots to modern rhythm.
https://armenopole.com/st-kevork-armenia: St. Kevork Armenian Apostolic Church hosts a community dinner fundraiser featuring duduk and clarinet virtuoso Ruben Harutyunyan and the St. Kevork Church Choir performing popular Armenian songs.
https://armenopole.com/fall-costume-danc: The Women's Guild of St. Mary hosts a family-friendly Fall Costume Dance Party featuring a DJ, LED robot, costume contest, kids' crafts, games, raffles, food, and a cash bar. No scary, gory, or violent costumes allowed.
https://armenopole.com/armen-daneghyan-p: Armen Daneghyan opens his personal exhibition featuring vibrant and colorful artwork.
https://armenopole.com/honouring-50-year: St. Mary Armenian Church of Hamilton marks its 50th anniversary with a gala celebration blessed by Bishop Abgar Hovakimyan. The evening features fine dining, live entertainment by Mher Minasian, and Armenian hospitality.
https://armenopole.com/nor-dzaghig-conce: The “Nor Dzaghig” Children’s Choir performs a concert conducted by Dr. Gohar Manvelyan with pianist Talar Harboyan-Kalloghlian. Sponsored by Mrs. Salpi Tashjian and Family, the event honors Elizabeth Bdghouni-Harboyan, the choir’s first conductor.

https://armenopole.com/hagop-usa.html: Hakob presents a Parisian night with an Armenian heart, featuring a special performance by the Hamazkayin Dance Ensemble. A vibrant cultural event celebrating Armenian identity through music and dance.
https://armenopole.com/love-homeland.htm: AGBU La Choir presents "Love & Homeland" featuring the OC Saturday School Children's Choir conducted by Nektar Mirakyan. The musical ensemble is led by Shushan Hakobyan. Proceeds benefit the Armenian Genocide Memorial at Orange County Great Park.

https://armenopole.com/atelier-de-cuisin: UGAB Lyon hosts a cooking workshop teaching the preparation of sou-beureg, a classic Armenian dish. Participants make every step from dough to baking, then enjoy the meal together in a warm, intergenerational atmosphere.

https://armenopole.com/raffi-zakarian-a-: Raffi Zakarian hosts a musical evening blending Armenian, Arab, and Greek traditions.
